title: Single-use Bureau runtime refresh for current main (candidate 17019)
goal: Execute exactly one new target-bound Bureau runtime refresh from the currently installed, ancestry-proven source 85ddb3ec42698f80740866447c2572e929ec5746 to the freshly observed protected heimgewebe/bureau main. The immediate purpose is to restore Bureau runtime/Registry identity so normal reviewed task publication can resume, including promotion of the kindeswohlgefaehrdung repository-registration follow-up. This authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, product-code, foreign-work or general repository authority.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound bootstrap only. The user explicitly instructed completing the current operator work; normal Bureau task publication is blocked by release-registry-identity-mismatch. No effect may start until fresh protected main/CI observation, exact target binding, authoritative TaskSpec adoption/activation, typed source-ancestry proof, live intent-bound Grabowski leases and runtime-refresh readback gates all pass. No blind retry after any effect-started ambiguity.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, GitHub main is freshly observed; the exact target contains this protected authority merge and all then-current legitimate main merges, and required validate (3.10), validate (3.12) and registry-registration-preflight/freshness checks for that exact main revision are successful.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again immediately before apply, a typed precondition readback proves that deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that this active source is exactly 85ddb3ec42698f80740866447c2572e929ec5746 or a verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main commit. Any identity mismatch, unrelated or diverged history, unavailable ancestry proof or target drift blocks the runtime effect fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and bureau runtime-identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, Kindeswohlgefährdung project, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. If the source-ancestry precondition fails or the new effect becomes unclear, preserve all precondition, attempt, intent, workspace, backup, manifest, Registry, authority and lease evidence and do not retry. Reconciliation requires a separately authorized successor path.
